novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a mechanistic decomposition: it predicts an identifiable "'prior' pathway and a 'reasoning' pathway" whose competition is resolved by "specific late-layer components," rather than merely reporting reasoning bias. Searches around "LLM plausibility logic conflict activation steering," "language prior reasoning circuits," and "recall versus reasoning activation patching" identify the closest work as Mitigating Content Effects on Reasoning in Language Models through Fine-Grained Activation Steering (2025), which already localizes formal-versus-plausible inference and steers internal activations, alongside Disentangling Recall and Reasoning in Transformer Models through Layer-wise Attention and Activation Analysis (2025), which proposes separable interacting recall and reasoning circuits. Moving to cross-domain conflict items and positing late-layer arbiter heads is a substantive multi-step integration and finer causal unit of analysis, but it is a natural extension of those prior mechanisms rather than a wholly new core paradigm.
